notes.random: It is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. This strategy was picked from the pc_cl_v4_15m finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, a one-setting-at-a-time neighbor check on 2023–2024) as well as 2018–2022, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First convexity look at the CL holdout. No price-path convexity strategy had been scored on CL 2025 onward before (apart from the final-test of this same frozen pick), and only this one, frozen beforehand, was run, so there's no selection among holdout results. Other strategy families were scored on CL 2025+ earlier (see the data-access ledgers), and convexity picks on other markets had already been scored on their 2025+ data before this one.

legs.settings_text: 15m bars, max-gap convexity over N = 20 bars, z-score over 250 bars, enter at |z| 1.5, every signal, net move at least 2 ATR, short only, hold N bars, no stop, no trend filter, flat at the close
